# Template:Bracket

<div id="bracket-usage-example" class="section mw-parser-output">

## Bracket usage example

This template creates squared brackets around an argument or if no text is given, will just create a \[ bracket.

    With text:
    &#123;&#123;bracket|Put this text into squared brackets&#125;&#125;

    Without text:
    &#123;&#123;bracket&#125;&#125;

With text: \[Put this text into squared brackets\]

Without text: \[

A bracket can be completed manually by using the rbracket template: \[[\[1\]](/templates/rbracket)\]

</div>
